title: Occidental Mindoro lifts ban on entry of live pigs for slaughter

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The provincial government of Occidental Mindoro has lifted its temporary ban on the entry of live pigs from provinces that were designated animal disease risk zones, while maintaining strict controls on incoming pork and pork products.
